suggested_fix: No fix required. The dirname buffer is sized from mangle_name() plus snprintf() of the same uniq_id value that sprintf() writes (post-increment), plus the NUL terminator. The rawdata symlink inodes hold the refcounted label proxy (aa_get_proxy is taken only after successful creation) rather than a raw pointer to profile->rawdata. All error paths unwind through __aafs_profile_rmdir().
